name: Invaders
author: Casper Bottelet
description: A faithful fixed-shooter in the spirit of the 1978 arcade classic: the marching grid, the accelerating four-note heartbeat, pixel-eroding bunkers and the saucer — drawn as chunky 8-bit sprites in your live theme colours. Summon with: omarchy-shell shell toggle bottelet.invaders

barWidget.description: Bar icon that summons the Invaders cabinet; high score in the tooltip
